about.title: Engineering Beyond the Code
about.introduction: For me, software engineering is more than writing code. It's about understanding complex problems, making thoughtful decisions, and building systems that remain reliable as they grow.

sections.title: How I Think
sections.description: I enjoy breaking down complex problems, understanding how systems behave under pressure, and finding practical solutions. I'm particularly interested in the challenges of concurrency, distributed systems, and data consistency.

sections.title: What Drives Me
sections.description: Curiosity keeps me learning. I like exploring new technologies, questioning architectural decisions, and turning ideas into working projects. Every experiment is an opportunity to become a better engineer.

sections.title: Beyond Engineering
sections.description: My long-term ambition is to build software products of my own. I'm interested in turning real problems into useful products, combining technical engineering with product thinking and entrepreneurship.
